entry.title: Payment processor raises fees for small merchants from January
entry.content: Example Payments will raise its per-transaction fee from 1.9 percent to 2.4 percent for merchants under $1 million in annual volume, effective 1 January. Merchants above that line keep the current rate. The change was announced in a blog post with no notice period beyond the sixty days required by its terms.
